_doc: Tekken 3 UI art wired into the Western Heart UI art pipeline (UI follow-up lane, 2026-10-24). Source: extracted T3 PlayStation TIM textures in teardown/tekken3/ui/ (see teardown/tekken3/ui/README.md: extracted from TEKKEN3.BNS via tools/local/tim_extract.py; they serve as TEMPLATES for AI-generating WH UI in the same style). COUNT NOTE: the lane brief said 7 TIM+PNG pairs; the repo actually holds 11 pairs in teardown/tekken3/ui/ — all 11 are registered below, none dropped. WIRING RULE (canon + ship law): the .tim files are PlayStation texture data and the .png files are their decoded previews; browsers cannot use .tim, so the PNG preview is the pipeline input. Raw T3 pixels NEVER ship in the WH UI — the PNGs are img2img / style-reference bases for GPU-generated WH UI art, and generated art ships ONLY after an owner eye-check. Depictions are NOT claimed below (this lane could not view the previews — the sandbox blocks PNG writes — so each entry records verified facts only: path, bytes, preview dimensions); the GPU contact sheet (tools/gpu/ui-followup-gpu-jobs.py, t3-assets mode) is the eye-check artifact that assigns final slots. Button notation in any generated UI text: LP1 = Left Punch = Tekken 1, RP2 = Right Punch = Tekken 2, LK3 = Left Kick = Tekken 3, RK4 = Right Kick = Tekken 4.

eye_check: REQUIRED before any generated art ships: owner reviews the GPU contact sheet + phone-size crops for every entry below and confirms slot + style. Until then, generated art is diagnostic only and every select/UI slot stays on its existing placeholder.
